name: wimbly
description: Wimbly is a Growth engine for legal and financial services.

interface.longDescription:
Wimbly is a Growth engine for legal and financial services. This repository contains its plugin for agents.

The current preview includes the onboarding skill, whose instructions are documented in the repository. An enrolled Wimbly account is required. Account connection is awaiting deployment and live sign-in testing.

publication.release_notes: Add the five positive and three negative onboarding cases required for directory review.

positive.description: Read setup progress for the signed-in reviewer account.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the account’s current setup state and show only the returned next step and Wimbly link. Do not invent progress or require the mail extension.

positive.description: Resume an unfinished setup in a new conversation.
positive.prompt: Continue my Wimbly onboarding from where I left off.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch current progress again, skip completed steps, and guide the next required step using the returned URL.

positive.description: Check again after a browser handoff.
positive.prompt: I finished the step on Wimbly’s website. What is next?
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch fresh progress before confirming completion. Advance only if the server records the completed step; otherwise explain the remaining step.

positive.description: Complete setup without an extension pairing. Use the reviewer account with mailbox, LinkedIn or archive request, About you review, and ideal-client review complete.
positive.prompt: Is my Wimbly account ready? I do not have the mail extension installed.
positive.expected_behavior: When the server returns ready, confirm setup is complete and describe the mail extension as optional. Do not claim mailbox or LinkedIn history import has finished.

positive.description: Repair a connection after setup was completed. Disconnect the sample mailbox through Wimbly before this case.
positive.prompt: I disconnected my mailbox after finishing setup. Help me reconnect it.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the recorded repair state and provide the returned mailbox reconnection link. Explain the repair without restarting completed profile reviews or calling the account new.

negative.description: Mailbox reading and sending are outside the onboarding plugin. No setup-progress tool should run.
negative.prompt: Read my latest Outlook email and send a reply confirming the meeting.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not trigger the onboarding skill or get_setup_status. Do not invent email content or claim a reply was sent; this plugin cannot read mail or send messages.

negative.description: Business-development research is outside the setup-only connection, despite Wimbly’s broader product description.
negative.prompt: My Wimbly account is already working. Find five CFO prospects for my law firm and draft an outreach campaign.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not trigger onboarding or call get_setup_status. Explain that this connection only guides account setup and cannot research prospects or create outreach.

negative.description: A request to configure another product must not match Wimbly onboarding.
negative.prompt: Help me set up Claude Code for this repository and configure its test command.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not trigger Wimbly onboarding or call get_setup_status. Address the repository setup request using the host’s relevant capabilities.

review.commerce_description: This onboarding plugin does not sell products or process payments.
